SELECT c.community_no, c.community_title, c.community_content, c.community_writer, DATE_FORMAT(c.community_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS community_date, c.view_count, m.member_name, m.member_thumb, m.member_grade, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_like_tbl l WHERE c.community_no = l.community_no) AS like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_dislike_tbl d WHERE c.community_no = d.community_no) AS dislike_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_report_tbl r WHERE c.community_no = r.community_no) AS report_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_comment_tbl cc WHERE c.community_no = cc.community_no) AS comment_count, ( SELECT hex_code FROM color_tbl WHERE color_id = ( SELECT current_color_id FROM member_tbl WHERE member_id = c.community_writer ) ) AS hex_code
,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_like_tbl cl WHERE cl.community_no = c.community_no AND cl.member_id = #{memberId}) AS is_like ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_dislike_tbl cd WHERE cd.community_no = c.community_no AND cd.member_id = #{memberId}) AS is_dislike
FROM community_tbl c JOIN member_tbl m ON c.community_writer = m.member_id WHERE c.community_status = 1
AND ( c.community_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR REGEXP_REPLACE(c.community_content, '<[^>]*>', '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') )
AND ( c.community_writer LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR m.member_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') )
AND m.member_grade = 3
AND m.member_grade IN (1, 2)
ORDER BY c.community_no DESC ORDER BY c.community_no ASC ORDER BY c.view_count DESC ORDER BY like_count DESC ORDER BY dislike_count DESC ORDER BY report_count DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET ${page*size}
